subject.title: fix(release): validate frozen runtime pair evidence

question: Should Release Checks accept this one frozen beta candidate’s nonzero runtime-pair result when—and only when—the trusted validator matches the declared SHA, core lane, 27-scenario ordering, and eight recorded Codex harness gaps?
rationale: This is an intentional release-gate exception, not an ordinary mechanical refactor; source tests can establish the guard shape but cannot decide whether the frozen evidence is acceptable for the beta release.

options.title: Accept the bounded exception
options.body: Merge after independently checking the referenced artifact against the validator’s exact target and gap identities and after required checks are clean.

options.title: Keep the candidate blocked
options.body: Require a newly generated candidate or a release-process change instead of permitting historical runtime-pair evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded exception
recommendation.body: Merge after independently checking the referenced artifact against the validator’s exact target and gap identities and after required checks are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history supplied with this review connects this person to both the current release-gate change and the merged adjacent runtime-harness repair.
